mapper.sql: select sum(internal_merchant) as "internal_merchant", SUM(external_merchant) as "external_merchant", sum(expiry_merchant) as "expiry_merchant" from (SELECT if(mmi.merchant_type = 0,1,0) as "internal_merchant", if(mmi.merchant_type = 1,1,0) as "external_merchant", if(mh.end_time < SYSDATE(),1,0) as "expiry_merchant" FROM merchant_manage_information mmi,merchant_holder mh
